_readme: Example golden-master fixture manifest, read by `overseer-gate.py golden-master` (see docs/modernization-shared.md#3-characterization--golden-master-tests). Each fixture must have been captured by running the LEGACY system against a known input and recording its real output/side-effect/exit-code -- 'source': 'legacy-run' -- never hand-authored from reading the code ('source': 'authored', which the gate does not count as coverage). One fixture may cover more than one constitution rule id.
